title: Fix IRFOC explicit lag handling at nonzero-history boundaries
description: Explicit lag notation like i(-1) falls back to zero outside the baseline window, even when the model exposes an exact lag alias column like ilag in the baseline. This makes i(-1) disagree with ilag at t=0 for shifted/nonzero-history baselines. Reuse exact lag alias columns when available and add regression tests.
close_reason: Completed: explicit lag notation now reuses exact lag alias columns at the left boundary, and lagged-rule residuals are populated

title: Support generic IRFOC prehistory for arbitrary lagged endogenous variables
description: IRFOC now handles explicit lag notation correctly when the model/baseline exposes an exact lag alias column such as ilag = i(-1). In-window lagged endogenous variables like pi(-1), y(-1), and pi(-2) work correctly, but at the left boundary t=0 explicit lags still fall back to zero unless matching alias columns or other presample history are provided. Follow up by deciding whether IRFOC should accept a generic presample history vector for arbitrary endogenous lags, infer it from baseline metadata, or document the alias-column requirement more explicitly.

title: Investigate SW IRFOC gap versus direct state-space counterfactual
description: A new SW integration check shows that IRFOC can reproduce a policy-parameter change counterfactual driven by an ea baseline shock only approximately, not to machine precision. With crr=0.70, crpi=2.40, cry=0.15, crdy=0.05 and a one-standard-deviation ea shock, the direct perfect-foresight state-space solution and the IRFOC path differ by roughly 2.6e-2 over the first 20 periods, even though the enforced policy-rule residual is effectively zero. Investigate whether this is an expected finite-horizon IRF approximation limit, a large-model conditioning problem, or a bug in the SW IRFOC mapping/replay path.
close_reason: Investigated and documented: the SW gap comes from IRFOC operating in the finite-horizon anticipated instrument-shock span of the baseline dynamics, so direct changed-parameter state-space paths need not be exact identities. Follow-on work moved to dsge-y4d for explicit reachability diagnostics.
